settings.label: Search containers and bodies
settings.description: Items appear one at a time while you search, like in Tarkov.

settings.label: Search speed
settings.description: Higher is faster. 1.0 is the intended pace.

settings.label: Search bodies too
settings.description: Bodies need searching just like containers.

settings.label: Holding an item pauses the search
settings.description: Like Tarkov: the search waits while you drag something.

settings.label: Condition affects search speed
settings.description: Overweight, fractures, bleeding, frostbite and insanity slow searching down.

settings.label: Bodies show their gear
settings.description: Weapons and worn gear on bodies are visible straight away; pockets and bags still need searching.

settings.label: Value borders
settings.description: Coloured frame on valuable items (value per cell): gold, purple, blue.

settings.label: Unknown items need examining
settings.description: Items you have never seen show as '?' until you examine them (middle-click, or right-click > Examine). Weapons and magazines still work while unknown.

settings.label: Middle-click to examine
settings.description: Middle mouse button on an unknown item starts examining it, like in Tarkov.

settings.label: Tarkov-style cell colors
settings.description: Tint inventory cells by item category; legendary items glow violet.

settings.label: Sound when an item is found
